verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'secure your data with Postman Vault' confirming Postman has a vault-type secrets feature, but the evidence pack gives no detail on external vault integrations (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) or on masked-secret variable behavior in environments. Community comments raise general trust concerns about secrets being sent to Postman's servers, but these are broad skepticism, not concrete evidence the masking/vault feature fails, so they don't rise to 'disputed'. missing for 10: details on external vault/secrets-manager integrations, explicit documentation of secret-type variable masking in environments/collections, and independent verification of vault security.
